# Capacity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Capacity`](gmeow-Capacity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Capacity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A measurement of the maximum number of entities a location can hold. The location is the [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md); the result is a [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md). The entity kind being counted is implicit from the location's [`placeType`](../properties/gmeow-placeType.md) and the [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md)'s [`hasUnit`](../properties/gmeow-hasUnit.md) (P11). A contested capacity (e.g., fire code vs. venue claim) is modelled as multiple co-existing [`Capacity`](gmeow-Capacity.md) measurements, each standpoint-indexed and confidence-weighted, never collapsing to a single winner (P9). A superseded capacity (e.g., after renovation) is suppressed via displayable false, never deleted (P10).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md)

Use [`gmeow:Capacity`](gmeow-Capacity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
